findings.claim: BYTE_REPRODUCIBILITY_OF_COMMITTED_PACKAGE_INPUT_SET_PLUS_REGENERATED_COMPARE_REFS from a detached clean HEAD temp tree
findings.failure_mode: tools/verify_oc133_reproducible_temp_tree.py deletes only COMPARE_REFS, then runs python tools/materialize_oc_core_1_3_3_v12_closure.py before packaging. That directly referenced producer rewrites non-COMPARE_REFS package/build inputs such as lean-toolchain, lakefile.lean, and formal/lean/OC133V12.lean before the certificate and package are regenerated. The verifier never snapshots and fails on non-COMPARE_REF mutations, so it proves that the generator can recreate the package after rewriting source inputs, not that the committed clean checkout source state can regenerate the current artifacts without masking stale source drift.
findings.required_repair: During reproducibility verification, either make materialization operate only on declared generated outputs or snapshot all tracked files before producers run and fail if any non-COMPARE_REF changes. Add all materialized package/build inputs to the comparison set or split source generation into a separate audited stage before artifact verification.

findings.claim: lakefile_ref/lakefile_sha256 and clean_source_manifest bind the Lake build file used for the clean Lean build
findings.failure_mode: The certificate reports lakefile_sha256 as 8fafb5c2541950face49cb3ef2c123e4508ad6b73b8506dd011e9c172bbd43d8, while the clean_source_manifest row for the same lakefile.lean reports df846df419c18077c055b71970a38ab26e53d38a24dc316efa877d93da566e9d. The artifacts do not label these as raw-vs-normalized digests, and proofs/finite_model_checks/run_finite_model_checks.py does not validate the top-level lakefile_sha256 field, so a stale build-input digest can remain undetected by the release gate.
findings.required_repair: Use one canonical source digest per referenced file or explicitly record raw_sha256 and normalized_sha256 with a hash_policy field, then update the certificate generator and finite-model gate to assert top-level lakefile/toolchain digests against current source bytes.
